description: Who this user has already contacted through Fundz or logged from chat: per person, the company, last subject and date, number of touches, whether they replied or booked, and when Fundz's next follow-up is due. Use it for "who have I not heard back from", to check a mailbox for replies from exactly these people, or before writing to a company. Costs one call from the daily API quota.

awaiting_reply.description: true to list only people who have not replied or booked

company.description: Limit to one company (id, slug, domain or name)

days.description: How far back to look (default 30, max 180)

name: get_outreach_history
title: Get outreach history
